diagnostics.message: `local_file.private_ssh_key` declares `depends_on = ["tls_private_key.ssh"]`, but its `content` attribute is `${tls_private_key.ssh.private_key_pem}`, which already establishes the same ordering implicitly. The explicit depends_on is redundant and can be removed.

`local_file.public_ssh_key` declares `depends_on = ["tls_private_key.ssh"]`, but its `content` attribute is `${tls_private_key.ssh.public_key_openssh}`, which already establishes the same ordering implicitly. The explicit depends_on is redundant and can be removed.

`aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance` launches the runner EC2 instance whose user-data script writes the registration token into `aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token` (Terraform creates it with value "null" and ignores later value changes). Nothing orders the ASG after the SSM parameter — the parameter name is only referenced as a string in the template — so the instance may boot and write/create the parameter before Terraform creates it, causing the `aws_ssm_parameter` create to fail (overwrite defaults to false on create). Add `depends_on = [aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token]` to the autoscaling group.
